decks.notes: This deck focuses on the combination of equipment and creatures to create a powerful and fast-paced offensive strategy. The key idea is to equip creatures with powerful equipment cards such as Colossus Hammer and Kaldra Compleat to quickly deal damage to opponents. The deck includes support cards like Stoneforge Mystic and Puresteel Paladin to search for and equip the necessary equipment. Cards like Giver of Runes and Esper Sentinel help to protect the creatures and maintain card advantage. The deck also utilizes Urza's Saga to search for key artifacts and Inkmoth Nexus as an alternate win condition.

The deck focuses on being aggressive and controlling the opponent through a combination of efficient threats and disruption. By utilizing cheap and powerful spells like Lightning Bolt, Counterspell, and Unholy Heat, the deck aims to maintain board presence while disrupting the opponent's game plan. Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler provide early pressure and card advantage, while Murktide Regent serves as a powerful finisher. The deck also includes cards like Force of Negation and Spell Pierce to protect its threats and maintain tempo. The mana base is streamlined to ensure consistency and efficiency in casting spells.

This deck focuses on using a combination of cards to quickly assemble powerful creatures on the battlefield to overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing cards like Indomitable Creativity and Persist, along with creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker, the deck aims to create a board state that is difficult for the opponent to deal with. The inclusion of removal spells like Terminate and Fatal Push helps to control the board while also setting up the combo pieces. The deck also includes cards like Thoughtseize and Bitter Reunion to disrupt the opponent's strategy and pave the way for victory.

The key concept of this UR Aggro deck is to maintain aggressive pressure on the opponent while controlling the game through card advantage and disruption. The deck achieves this by utilizing efficient and evasive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler, backed up by cheap interaction like Lightning Bolt and Counterspell. The deck also includes card selection and filtering tools such as Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration to ensure consistent draws and maximize efficiency. The mana base is built to support both red and blue spells, allowing for a flexible and versatile playstyle.

The main focus of this deck is to control the opponent's plays through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and versatile planeswalkers. It aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while generating card advantage and value through powerful cards such as Wrenn and Six, Teferi, Time Raveler, and Expressive Iteration. The deck also utilizes powerful threats like Solitude and Omnath, Locus of Creation to close out the game quickly once it has gained control. The land base is carefully crafted to ensure consistent mana sources and to support the various color requirements of the deck.

Utilizing a variety of cards that interact with each other to create unexpected and powerful combinations, this deck focuses on quickly assembling and casting powerful creatures while disrupting opponent's plans. By leveraging the synergy between cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker, Indomitable Creativity, and Leyline Binding, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with powerful threats and control elements. The inclusion of cards like Archon of Cruelty and Wrenn and Six provide additional versatility and consistency to ensure the deck's success in a Modern 1 vs 1 format.

The main focus of this deck is to aggressively control the board while quickly reducing the opponent's life total. Utilizing efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent, along with a mix of cheap removal and counterspells, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while applying pressure. Mishra's Bauble and Consider help to filter through the deck for key cards, while Expressive Iteration provides card advantage. The mana base supports the deck's aggressive strategy by enabling early plays and consistent access to necessary colors of mana.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly and aggressively fill the graveyard with cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler, while controlling the board with cards like Lightning Bolt and Counterspell. The deck aims to efficiently cast big threats like Murktide Regent and utilize cards like Mishra's Bauble and Unholy Heat to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The mix of aggression and disruption allows the deck to maintain pressure on the opponent while also protecting itself, ultimately leading to a strong and consistent win condition.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly using cards like Arboreal Grazer, Sakura-Tribe Elder, and Azusa, Lost but Seeking, in order to cast powerful threats like Primeval Titan and Cultivator Colossus. The key combo involves utilizing Amulet of Vigor to untap lands and generate extra mana, enabling explosive plays and setting up lethal attacks with lands like Vesuva and Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle. Through careful sequencing and efficient use of cards like Urza's Saga and Summoner's Pact, the deck can quickly overwhelm opponents and close out games in a single turn.

The deck focuses on utilizing Cascade cards to quickly overwhelm the opponent with powerful spells and creatures on the battlefield. By chaining together cascade triggers, the deck aims to consistently put pressure on the opponent and create a fast-paced game. The inclusion of cards like Fury and Violent Outburst provides additional ways to trigger Cascade, while cards like Shardless Agent and Leyline Binding help to maintain board presence and control. The mana base is carefully constructed to ensure smooth gameplay and efficient casting of spells.

The main concept of this Dredge combo deck is to rapidly fill the graveyard with cards like Stinkweed Imp and Golgari Thug, while also triggering effects that bring back creatures like Prized Amalgam and Narcomoeba from the graveyard. By utilizing spells like Cathartic Reunion and Otherworldly Gaze, this deck can quickly generate enough graveyard power to overwhelm the opponent with creatures and burn spells like Creeping Chill and Conflagrate. The deck is designed to put pressure on the opponent early and maintain a steady stream of threats throughout the game.

This deck aims to quickly assemble the combo of equipping Colossus Hammer onto a creature, such as Kor Outfitter or Gingerbrute, and swinging for lethal damage with the help of Puresteel Paladin and Sigarda's Aid. With cards like Stoneforge Mystic and Urza's Saga to tutor for key pieces, as well as protection from Giver of Runes and Spell Pierce, this deck is all about fast-paced, explosive turns where even the toughest opponents can quickly find themselves overwhelmed by the sheer power and speed of the Hammer Time combo.

This deck utilizes powerful Elemental creatures and control spells to disrupt the opponent's game plan while building a strong board presence. The key strategy is to ramp into Omnath, Locus of Creation and leverage its powerful abilities to generate value and close out the game quickly. The inclusion of Kaheera, the Orphanguard as a companion provides additional synergy with the Elemental tribal theme of the deck. By combining efficient removal spells and resilient threats, this deck aims to control the game and outvalue the opponent in the late game.

The focus of this deck is to play aggressively using low cost creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler, while controlling the board with cards like Counterspell and Lightning Bolt. The deck also includes card advantage engines like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration to maintain tempo. The mana base is optimized for consistent access to all colors needed. Overall, the deck aims to apply early pressure and maintain control of the game through a combination of aggression and disruption.

The deck focuses on utilizing efficient and versatile spells like Lightning Bolt, Counterspell, and Unholy Heat to control the board while quickly establishing a board presence with creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent. By disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells and removal spells, while applying pressure with evasive threats, the deck aims to close out the game as quickly as possible. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Expressive Iteration and Mishra's Bauble allow for card selection and card advantage to help maintain momentum throughout the game.

The main idea of this deck is to apply pressure on the opponent quickly by playing aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler, while also disrupting their game plan with cards like Counterspell and Lightning Bolt. The deck also includes card draw and filtering spells like Expressive Iteration and Consider to maintain consistency. Additionally, the inclusion of Underworld Breach allows for powerful combo plays. The mana base is designed to support the dual color requirements of the deck, with some fetch lands for thinning the deck and fixing mana.
